title: Muryar Daga Dajin Da Ke Konewa
intro: Bayyana asalin wani mutum mai zurfi wanda tafiyarsa ta fara da wani abin al'ajabi kuma makomarsa tana da alaƙa da 'yantar da mutanen da aka zalunta. An zaɓi wannan mutum don wani babban aiki, yana fuskantar manyan ƙalubale tare da taimakon Allah.
clues: An haife ni a lokacin zalunci mai tsanani, inda ake kashe jarirai na mutanena.
Rayuwata ta farko ta ƙunshi sanya ni a cikin kogi ta hannun iyayena, duk da haka an same ni kuma an rene ni a cikin gidan mai zaluntar mutanena.
Na taɓa tserewa daga wani birni bayan na yi sanadiyyar mutuwar wani mutum ba da gangan ba a lokacin wata takaddama.
Na sami saƙon allahntaka da sanda mai ban mamaki a wani wuri mai tsarki, inda aka umarce ni da in fuskanci wani mai iko.
An naɗa ɗan'uwana a matsayin mataimaki a gare ni a cikin aikina, saboda wani abin da na gani yana kawo cikas a cikin jawabina.
Na jagoranci mutanena zuwa ketaren teku da aka raba, ina tserewa daga bin rundunar azzalumai.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verse: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]." (20:77)
